notes: YEAR-ONLY shipment per established precedent: the year digits are text-verified and only the month letter is chart-only. Page text: 8-character serial, 1 letter followed by 7 digits; year from the combined 2nd and 3rd characters; month from the 1st letter via a chart. Counting note: the 2nd and 3rd characters of the page example A0407142 are '04' (2004); counting numerical digits only would give '40', which cannot decode under the century rule, and the page's own styling highlights the A04 prefix, so the character-position reading is the one encoded. Month letter table is image-only and is NOT encoded: chart image Aqua-Star_Benjamin-Serial-Number-Nomenclature.png (https://building-center.org/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/Aqua-Star_Benjamin-Serial-Number-Nomenclature.png) is an image-pass item. Page names Aqua Star as a sister/similar brand; shared-system use by Aqua Star is not separately verified here, so no sisters claim is made.
